verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents Cortex Analyst, which lets users ask natural-language questions and get direct answers without writing SQL. The homepage markets 'Snowflake CoWork' ('Ask anything') and 'CoCo' ('Build anything'), and the MCP docs reference Cortex Agents, but none of this shows an in-product assistant taking on and executing multi-step tasks. Missing for 10: documented in-product agent delegation (an assistant that performs actions beyond Q&A), substantive docs for CoWork/CoCo beyond taglines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
